name: footval
description: Football match predictions for every game of Europe's top leagues — win, draw and loss chances, likeliest score, likely scorers and predicted line-ups — plus season projections with each club's title, top-four and relegation chances, independent player valuations with the reasons behind them, scouting, live scores, match centres, league tables, season statistics and transfer news.

interface.longDescription:
FootVal brings football match predictions, season projections, player valuations and live scores into ChatGPT.

Ask who will win a match and get FootVal's prediction for any game of the leagues it covers: the model's chances of a home win, a draw and an away win, the likeliest scores, total goals and both teams to score, the likeliest scorers and the predicted line-ups, replaced by the confirmed ones about an hour before kick-off. Every morning the model also locks in its 10 most confident calls of the day and grades each one after the final whistle, so its hit rate over the last 7 and 30 days stays on the record.

Ask who will win the league and get FootVal's season projection: the rest of the season played out thousands of times, with every club's chance of the title, the top four and the Champions League places, Europe and relegation, and its expected points.

Ask what a footballer is worth and get FootVal's estimated transfer value next to the market value, with the factors that explain the gap: performance, age and potential, contract, durability, reputation and form. Compare up to four players, scout by league, club, nation, position, age, preferred foot and value, and list the most undervalued and overvalued players, the biggest risers and the best young talents.

FootVal also covers live football: scores and fixtures, match centres with events, team statistics and line-ups, league tables, a team's next and recent matches, season leaderboards for goals and assists, and the latest transfer news. Results appear as interactive cards you can tap through to a player, club, league or match.

Who it is for: football fans, fantasy managers, writers and anyone curious about how matches and seasons might go and what players are worth.

Good to know: FootVal's predictions, projections and values are model estimates, not betting advice, financial advice or offers, and FootVal shows no betting odds. Predictions cover the European top divisions plus the Saudi Pro League; live data covers the competitions FootVal follows. FootVal is read-only: it never posts, buys or changes anything. Connecting requires signing in to FootVal.
capabilities: Predict any match: win, draw and loss chances
Likeliest scores, goals and likely scorers
Season projections: title, top-four and relegation chances
The day's 10 most confident calls with a public track record
Estimate a player's transfer value and explain it
Find undervalued, overvalued and rising players
Scout players by league, position, age and value
Live scores, match centres and league tables
defaultPrompt: Predict Real Madrid's next match: chances, likely scorers and line-ups.
Who will win the Premier League this season, and who will go down?
What is Lamine Yamal really worth, and why?

positive.description: Value one player and explain the gap to the market.
positive.prompt: What is Lamine Yamal really worth according to FootVal?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Lamine Yamal's FootVal estimated transfer value next to his market value with the percentage gap and a verdict (undervalued, fair or overvalued), explains the biggest valuation factors (performance, age potential, contract, durability, reputation, form) and renders the player card with value history and recent season stats.

positive.description: Compare two players side by side.
positive.prompt: Compare Arda Güler and Florian Wirtz.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns both players' FootVal and market values, age, position, performance percentile, every valuation factor and last-season output in a side-by-side comparison card, and summarises who FootVal rates higher and why.

positive.description: Rank the most undervalued players in one league.
positive.prompt: Who are the most undervalued players in the Premier League right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of Premier League players (market value of at least €10M) whose FootVal value most exceeds their market value, each with both values and the gap, rendered as a ranking card.

positive.description: Show today's match predictions and the model's recent record.
positive.prompt: What are FootVal's match predictions for today, and how accurate has the model been lately?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current prediction day of FootVal's match model: up to 10 calls, each with the match, the call (match result, double chance, total goals or both teams to score), the model's probability, the likeliest score and scorer and, once played, the score and whether the call was right, plus the model's hit rate over the last 7 and 30 days, rendered as a predictions card. The answer presents them as model probabilities, not as odds or betting advice.

positive.prompt: Find left-footed centre-backs aged 23 or under in Serie A.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a shortlist of Serie A centre-backs aged 23 or younger whose preferred foot is left, sorted by FootVal value, each with the market value alongside and the gap, rendered as a player list card.

negative.description: FootVal sells nothing and takes no actions, so a ticket purchase must not trigger it; the assistant should explain it cannot buy tickets.
negative.prompt: Buy me two tickets for the next Galatasaray home match.

negative.description: FootVal covers football only, so a basketball question must not trigger it.
negative.prompt: Who won the NBA Finals last year?

negative.description: An everyday question unrelated to football must not trigger FootVal.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Istanbul tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: FootVal sells nothing in ChatGPT or Codex and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.1.0 predicts every match of the leagues FootVal covers, not only the day's 10 most confident calls: the win, draw and loss chances, likeliest scores, goals, likeliest scorers and the predicted line-ups (the confirmed ones about an hour before kick-off), in a new match prediction card that the match centre now carries too. Season projections give every club's chance of the title, the top four, Europe and relegation. The match tools understand more competition names (League Cup, Primeira Liga, DFB-Pokal, Brasileirão…) and now follow the League Cup, Brasileirão Série B, the Egyptian Premier League and Belgium's Challenger Pro League.

tr-TR.subtitle: Tahminler, değerler, skorlar
tr-TR.description:
FootVal, futbol maç tahminlerini, sezon tahminlerini, futbolcu değerlemelerini ve canlı skorları ChatGPT'ye getirir.

Bir maçı kimin kazanacağını sorun: FootVal'in kapsadığı liglerdeki her maç için tahminini görün — ev sahibi galibiyeti, beraberlik ve deplasman galibiyeti ihtimalleri, en olası skorlar, toplam gol ve karşılıklı gol, en olası golcüler ve muhtemel 11'ler (resmi kadrolar maçtan yaklaşık bir saat önce yerini alır). Model her sabah günün en emin olduğu 10 tahminini de kilitler ve maç bitince her birini işaretler; son 7 ve 30 gündeki isabet oranı kayıtta kalır.

Ligi kimin kazanacağını sorun: FootVal'in sezon tahmini sezonun geri kalanını binlerce kez oynatır; her takımın şampiyonluk, ilk 4 ve Şampiyonlar Ligi, Avrupa ve küme düşme ihtimalini ve beklenen puanını verir.

Bir futbolcunun ne kadar ettiğini sorun: FootVal'in tahmini bonservis değerini piyasa değerinin yanında, aradaki farkı açıklayan faktörlerle (performans, yaş ve potansiyel, sözleşme, sakatlık geçmişi, itibar ve form) görün. Dört oyuncuya kadar karşılaştırın; lig, kulüp, milli takım, mevki, yaş, ayak ve değere göre oyuncu arayın; en çok değerinin altında ve üstünde fiyatlanan oyuncuları, en çok yükselenleri ve en iyi gençleri listeleyin.

FootVal canlı futbolu da kapsar: skorlar ve fikstür, olaylar, takım istatistikleri ve kadrolarla maç merkezi, puan durumları, bir takımın sıradaki ve son maçları, gol ve asist liderleri ile son transfer haberleri. Sonuçlar oyuncu, kulüp, lig ve maç detayına geçebileceğiniz etkileşimli kartlarla gelir.

Bilinmesi gerekenler: FootVal'in tahminleri ve değerleri model tahminleridir; bahis tavsiyesi, finansal tavsiye ya da teklif değildir ve FootVal bahis oranı göstermez. FootVal yalnızca okur: hiçbir şey paylaşmaz, satın almaz ya da değiştirmez. Bağlanmak için FootVal'e giriş yapmak gerekir.

de-DE.subtitle: Prognosen, Werte & Ergebnisse
de-DE.description:
FootVal bringt Fußball-Spielprognosen, Saisonprognosen, Spielerbewertungen und Live-Ergebnisse in ChatGPT.

Fragen Sie, wer ein Spiel gewinnt, und erhalten Sie FootVals Prognose für jedes Spiel der abgedeckten Ligen: die Chancen auf Heimsieg, Remis und Auswärtssieg, die wahrscheinlichsten Ergebnisse, Tore und ob beide Teams treffen, die wahrscheinlichsten Torschützen und die voraussichtlichen Aufstellungen, die etwa eine Stunde vor Anpfiff durch die offiziellen ersetzt werden. Jeden Morgen legt das Modell außerdem seine 10 sichersten Prognosen des Tages fest und bewertet jede nach dem Abpfiff; die Trefferquote der letzten 7 und 30 Tage bleibt nachvollziehbar.

Fragen Sie, wer Meister wird, und erhalten Sie FootVals Saisonprognose: Der Rest der Saison wird tausendfach durchgespielt, mit den Chancen jedes Vereins auf Meisterschaft, Top 4 und Champions-League-Plätze, Europa und Abstieg sowie seinen erwarteten Punkten.

Fragen Sie, was ein Spieler wert ist, und sehen Sie FootVals geschätzten Transferwert neben dem Marktwert, mit den Faktoren, die den Unterschied erklären: Leistung, Alter und Potenzial, Vertrag, Verletzungsanfälligkeit, Reputation und Form. Vergleichen Sie bis zu vier Spieler, suchen Sie nach Liga, Verein, Nation, Position, Alter, starkem Fuß und Wert und listen Sie die am stärksten unter- und überbewerteten Spieler, die größten Aufsteiger und die besten Talente auf.

FootVal deckt auch den Live-Fußball ab: Ergebnisse und Spielpläne, Spielzentralen mit Ereignissen, Statistiken und Aufstellungen, Tabellen, die nächsten und letzten Spiele eines Teams, Bestenlisten für Tore und Vorlagen sowie aktuelle Transfernachrichten. Die Ergebnisse erscheinen als interaktive Karten, über die Sie zu Spieler, Verein, Liga oder Spiel weiterklicken.

Gut zu wissen: FootVals Prognosen und Werte sind Modellschätzungen, keine Wett- oder Finanzberatung und keine Angebote, und FootVal zeigt keine Wettquoten. FootVal liest nur: Es veröffentlicht, kauft oder ändert nichts. Für die Verbindung ist eine Anmeldung bei FootVal nötig.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pronostics, valeurs et scores
fr-FR.description:
FootVal apporte dans ChatGPT des pronostics de matchs, des projections de saison, des valorisations de footballeurs et des scores en direct.

Demandez qui va gagner un match et obtenez le pronostic de FootVal pour chaque match des ligues couvertes : les chances de victoire à domicile, de nul et de victoire à l'extérieur, les scores les plus probables, le total de buts et les deux équipes qui marquent, les buteurs les plus probables et les compositions probables, remplacées par les officielles environ une heure avant le coup d'envoi. Chaque matin, le modèle fige aussi ses 10 pronostics les plus sûrs du jour et note chacun après le coup de sifflet final ; son taux de réussite sur 7 et 30 jours reste consultable.

Demandez qui sera champion et obtenez la projection de saison de FootVal : la fin de saison rejouée des milliers de fois, avec pour chaque club ses chances de titre, de top 4 et de Ligue des champions, d'Europe et de relégation, et ses points attendus.

Demandez ce que vaut un joueur et voyez la valeur de transfert estimée par FootVal à côté de la valeur marchande, avec les facteurs qui expliquent l'écart : performance, âge et potentiel, contrat, fiabilité physique, réputation et forme. Comparez jusqu'à quatre joueurs, cherchez par ligue, club, sélection, poste, âge, pied fort et valeur, et listez les joueurs les plus sous-évalués et surévalués, les plus fortes hausses et les meilleurs jeunes.

FootVal couvre aussi le football en direct : scores et calendrier, centres de match avec événements, statistiques et compositions, classements, prochains et derniers matchs d'une équipe, classements des buteurs et passeurs, et l'actualité des transferts. Les résultats s'affichent en cartes interactives qui mènent à un joueur, un club, une ligue ou un match.

À savoir : les pronostics et valeurs de FootVal sont des estimations de modèle, pas des conseils de paris ni des conseils financiers, et FootVal n'affiche aucune cote. FootVal se contente de lire : il ne publie, n'achète et ne modifie rien. La connexion nécessite un compte FootVal.

es-ES.subtitle: Pronósticos, valor y partidos
es-ES.description:
FootVal lleva a ChatGPT pronósticos de partidos, proyecciones de temporada, valoraciones de futbolistas y resultados en directo.

Pregunta quién ganará un partido y obtén el pronóstico de FootVal para cualquier partido de las ligas que cubre: las opciones de victoria local, empate y victoria visitante, los resultados más probables, los goles totales y si marcan ambos equipos, los goleadores más probables y las alineaciones probables, que se sustituyen por las oficiales una hora antes del partido, aproximadamente. Cada mañana el modelo fija además sus 10 pronósticos más seguros del día y califica cada uno tras el pitido final; su porcentaje de aciertos de los últimos 7 y 30 días queda a la vista.

Pregunta quién ganará la liga y obtén la proyección de temporada de FootVal: el resto de la temporada jugado miles de veces, con las opciones de cada club de ganar el título, acabar entre los cuatro primeros y en puestos de Champions, jugar en Europa o descender, y sus puntos esperados.

Pregunta cuánto vale un jugador y ve el valor de traspaso estimado por FootVal junto al valor de mercado, con los factores que explican la diferencia: rendimiento, edad y potencial, contrato, historial de lesiones, reputación y forma. Compara hasta cuatro jugadores, busca por liga, club, selección, posición, edad, pierna y valor, y consulta los jugadores más infravalorados y sobrevalorados, los que más suben y los mejores jóvenes.

FootVal también cubre el fútbol en directo: resultados y calendario, centros de partido con incidencias, estadísticas y alineaciones, clasificaciones, los próximos y últimos partidos de un equipo, los máximos goleadores y asistentes y las últimas noticias de fichajes. Los resultados aparecen como tarjetas interactivas que llevan a un jugador, club, liga o partido.

A tener en cuenta: los pronósticos y valores de FootVal son estimaciones de un modelo, no consejos de apuestas, asesoramiento financiero ni ofertas, y FootVal no muestra cuotas. FootVal solo lee: no publica, no compra ni cambia nada. Para conectarlo hay que iniciar sesión en FootVal.

it-IT.subtitle: Pronostici, valori e risultati
it-IT.description:
FootVal porta in ChatGPT pronostici delle partite, proiezioni stagionali, valutazioni dei calciatori e risultati in diretta.

Chiedi chi vincerà una partita e ottieni il pronostico di FootVal per ogni partita dei campionati coperti: le probabilità di vittoria in casa, pareggio e vittoria in trasferta, i risultati esatti più probabili, i gol totali e se segnano entrambe, i marcatori più probabili e le probabili formazioni, sostituite da quelle ufficiali circa un'ora prima del calcio d'inizio. Ogni mattina il modello fissa anche i suoi 10 pronostici più sicuri del giorno e li valuta dopo il fischio finale; la percentuale di successo degli ultimi 7 e 30 giorni resta consultabile.

Chiedi chi vincerà il campionato e ottieni la proiezione stagionale di FootVal: il resto della stagione rigiocato migliaia di volte, con le probabilità di ogni squadra di vincere il titolo, chiudere tra le prime quattro e nei posti Champions, andare in Europa o retrocedere, e i suoi punti attesi.

Chiedi quanto vale un giocatore e vedi il valore di trasferimento stimato da FootVal accanto al valore di mercato, con i fattori che spiegano la differenza: rendimento, età e potenziale, contratto, tenuta fisica, reputazione e forma. Confronta fino a quattro giocatori, cerca per campionato, club, nazionale, ruolo, età, piede e valore, ed elenca i giocatori più sottovalutati e sopravvalutati, quelli in maggiore crescita e i migliori giovani.

FootVal copre anche il calcio in diretta: risultati e calendario, centri partita con eventi, statistiche e formazioni, classifiche, le prossime e ultime partite di una squadra, le classifiche di marcatori e assist e le ultime notizie di mercato. I risultati appaiono come schede interattive che portano a un giocatore, un club, un campionato o una partita.

Da sapere: pronostici e valori di FootVal sono stime di un modello, non consigli di scommessa, consulenza finanziaria o offerte, e FootVal non mostra quote. FootVal legge soltanto: non pubblica, non acquista e non modifica nulla. Per collegarlo serve un accesso a FootVal.

pt-BR.subtitle: Palpites, valores e placares
pt-BR.description:
O FootVal traz para o ChatGPT palpites de jogos, projeções de temporada, avaliações de jogadores e placares ao vivo.

Pergunte quem vai vencer um jogo e veja o palpite do FootVal para qualquer partida das ligas que ele cobre: as chances de vitória do mandante, empate e vitória do visitante, os placares mais prováveis, total de gols e se ambos marcam, os prováveis goleadores e as prováveis escalações, substituídas pelas oficiais cerca de uma hora antes do jogo. Toda manhã o modelo também crava os 10 palpites mais confiantes do dia e avalia cada um após o apito final; o aproveitamento dos últimos 7 e 30 dias fica registrado.

Pergunte quem vai ser campeão e veja a projeção de temporada do FootVal: o restante da temporada jogado milhares de vezes, com as chances de cada clube de ser campeão, ficar no G4 e nas vagas da Champions League, ir para competições europeias ou ser rebaixado, além dos pontos esperados.

Pergunte quanto vale um jogador e veja o valor de transferência estimado pelo FootVal ao lado do valor de mercado, com os fatores que explicam a diferença: desempenho, idade e potencial, contrato, histórico de lesões, reputação e fase. Compare até quatro jogadores, busque por liga, clube, seleção, posição, idade, pé preferido e valor, e veja os jogadores mais subvalorizados e supervalorizados, os que mais valorizaram e os melhores jovens.

O FootVal também cobre o futebol ao vivo: placares e calendário, central do jogo com lances, estatísticas e escalações, classificações, os próximos e últimos jogos de um time, artilharia e assistências e as últimas notícias de transferências. Os resultados aparecem em cards interativos que levam a um jogador, clube, liga ou partida.

Bom saber: os palpites e valores do FootVal são estimativas de um modelo, não dicas de apostas, aconselhamento financeiro nem ofertas, e o FootVal não mostra odds. O FootVal apenas lê: não publica, não compra e não altera nada. Para conectar é preciso entrar no FootVal.
